SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) * 1.0 / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 91 AND 120
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy

# Analyze May (doy 91-120) and October (doy 287-310) patterns
import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# May analysis
may_data = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 2) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 91) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 120)]
may_by_day = may_data.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'cls': lambda x: ', '.join(x.unique()[:3])
}).reset_index()
may_by_day['yt_per_angler'] = (may_by_day['yt'] / may_by_day['anglers']).round(3)
may_peak = may_by_day.loc[may_by_day['yt_per_angler'].idxmax()]

print("MAY PEAK (DOY 91-120):")
print(may_by_day.to_string())
print(f"\nMay total YT: {may_data['yt'].sum()}, total anglers: {may_data['anglers'].sum()}")
print(f"May peak: DOY {int(may_peak['fish_date_doy'])}, {may_peak['yt_per_angler']} yt/angler")

# October analysis (DOY 287-310 = Oct 14-Nov 6)
oct_data = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 2) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 287) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 310)]
oct_by_day = oct_data.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
}).reset_index()
oct_by_day['yt_per_angler'] = (oct_by_day['yt'] / oct_by_day['anglers']).round(3)
if len(oct_by_day) > 0:
    oct_peak = oct_by_day.loc[oct_by_day['yt_per_angler'].idxmax()]
    print(f"\n\nOCTOBER PEAK (DOY 287-310):")
    print(oct_by_day.to_string())
    print(f"\nOctober total YT: {oct_data['yt'].sum()}, total anglers: {oct_data['anglers'].sum()}")
    print(f"October peak: DOY {int(oct_peak['fish_date_doy'])}, {oct_peak['yt_per_angler']} yt/angler")
else:
    print("\nOCTOBER: No data yet (future dates)")

result = "Analysis complete"

# Check what seasons are in the data and analyze historical October patterns
import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# Get unique seasons
seasons = trips['fish_date_season'].unique()
print("Available seasons:", sorted(seasons))

# Look at Season 1 October (DOY 287-310)
s1_oct = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 1) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 287) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 310)]
if len(s1_oct) > 0:
    s1_oct_by_day = s1_oct.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
        'yt': 'sum',
        'anglers': 'sum',
        'boat': 'nunique'
    }).reset_index()
    s1_oct_by_day['yt_per_angler'] = (s1_oct_by_day['yt'] / s1_oct_by_day['anglers']).round(3)
    
    print("\n\nSEASON 1 OCTOBER (DOY 287-310):")
    print(s1_oct_by_day.to_string())
    print(f"\nS1 Oct total YT: {s1_oct['yt'].sum()}, total anglers: {s1_oct['anglers'].sum()}")
    print(f"S1 Oct average yt/angler: {(s1_oct['yt'].sum() / s1_oct['anglers'].sum()):.3f}")
    
    # Best boats in October
    s1_oct_boats = s1_oct.groupby('boat').agg({
        'yt': 'sum',
        'anglers': 'sum',
    }).reset_index()
    s1_oct_boats['yt_per_angler'] = (s1_oct_boats['yt'] / s1_oct_boats['anglers']).round(3)
    s1_oct_boats = s1_oct_boats.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
    print("\n\nBEST BOATS IN S1 OCTOBER:")
    print(s1_oct_boats.head(10).to_string())

# Also check July-September to confirm summer is dead
s2_summer = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 2) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 182) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 286)]
if len(s2_summer) > 0:
    s2_summer_by_mo = s2_summer.groupby((s2_summer['fish_date_doy'] // 30)).agg({
        'yt': 'sum',
        'anglers': 'sum',
    }).reset_index()
    s2_summer_by_mo['yt_per_angler'] = (s2_summer_by_mo['yt'] / s2_summer_by_mo['anglers']).round(3)
    print("\n\nS2 SUMMER (DOY 182-286):")
    print(f"Total YT: {s2_summer['yt'].sum()}, total anglers: {s2_summer['anglers'].sum()}")
    print(f"Average yt/angler: {(s2_summer['yt'].sum() / s2_summer['anglers'].sum()):.3f}")

result = "Historical analysis complete"

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  cls,
  landing,
  boat,
  anglers,
  yt,
  SUM(yt) OVER (PARTITION BY fish_date_doy, cls) as total_yt_that_day_cls,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fish_date_doy, cls) as trips_that_day_cls
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as unique_boats,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  MAX(yt) as max_boat_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY total_yt DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT 
  report_date_doy as doy,
  yt_all,
  yt_local,
  yt_coronado,
  yt_north,
  text
FROM fishdope
WHERE report_date_season = 2
ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats_sailing,
  COUNT(*) as total_schedules
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 122 AND 160
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
